research_mode: official data.police.uk and Department for Transport primary sources only; anonymisation, provenance, API retrieval, STATS19 coverage, revision, severity and quality gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk monthly publication frequency
verified_claims: crime, anti-social behaviour and outcome data are published on a monthly frequency
limitations: monthly publication is not a real-time incident feed

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk geographic coverage
verified_claims: the published dataset covers England, Wales and Northern Ireland
limitations: coverage and contributing organisations differ by data type and jurisdiction

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk Open Government Licence gate
verified_claims: the dataset is made available under the Open Government Licence v3.0
limitations: the licence does not remove privacy, attribution or source-quality constraints

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk monthly archive structure
verified_claims: complete monthly CSV archives use a consistent year-month URL structure
limitations: archive availability does not imply that every force-month is complete or revision-free

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk subset-access interfaces
verified_claims: custom CSV download and JSON API interfaces are provided for accessing subsets instead of the full archive
limitations: subset queries can omit records outside the requested time or geometry

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk reported-by field
verified_claims: the Reported by field identifies the force that supplied the crime data
limitations: the supplying force is not necessarily a parcel-level jurisdictional determination

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk falls-within field caveat
verified_claims: the Falls within field currently also identifies the supplying force and is under review
limitations: the field must not be treated as a stable independent geographic classification

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk LSOA assignment gate
verified_claims: published LSOA fields refer to the LSOA containing the anonymised map point
limitations: the LSOA may reflect the anonymised point rather than the exact incident location

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk latest-outcome field
verified_claims: Last outcome category refers to the most recent outcome associated with the crime
limitations: the field is not a complete case history and can change after later updates

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk multi-provider provenance
verified_claims: data are supplied by geographic police forces, British Transport Police, Police Service of Northern Ireland and the Ministry of Justice
limitations: provider coverage varies by record type and should be retained during joins

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk monthly force file flow
verified_claims: each force generates monthly Crime and ASB and Police Outcomes files in a prescribed format
limitations: file generation processes vary across force source systems

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk Ministry of Justice matching flow
verified_claims: crime records sent to the Ministry of Justice are matched to available court results and returned for integration
limitations: court-result matching is not guaranteed to find every relevant record

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police system-silo quality caveat
verified_claims: siloed force systems can require manual joining and double-keying, increasing quality risk
limitations: the caveat does not quantify error for an individual force-month

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk Crime and ASB file scope
verified_claims: the monthly Crime and ASB file contains records for incidents from the previous month
limitations: published records are transformed and anonymised before release

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk outcome update lag
verified_claims: a monthly outcomes file can contain updates for crimes that occurred many months earlier
limitations: outcome month must not be assumed to equal crime month
